subject: del_M parameter to calculate ultimate size

messages.author: 54d4981d6bf68eaf
messages.subject: del_M parameter to calculate ultimate size
parts:
Hi Mike!

I am trying to calculate ultimate size for a bunch of species from the DEB parameters in allStat, and for that I need to divide L_i by del_M. However, I am not able to find the del_M parameter. Is del_M not available in allStat? Do I need to get them from the individual entries in addmypet?

Thanks a lot in advance! 

All the best,

Urtzi

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: del_M parameter to calculate ultimate size
parts:
Hi Urtzi,
It's possibly not there for species that had no length data. Check here to see if that's indeed the case. del_M is just a way to go from whatever the chosen length measure is (e.g., could be head width, SVL) to structural length. So you could independently work it out if you had independent length data for your organism.
All the best,
Mike
